name: 21465-multiimage-qwen3vl32b-tp4
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, no quantization_config: a 27-layer ViT vision tower feeding a 64-layer Qwen3 language model (hidden 5120, 64 attention heads over 8 KV heads). 63 GB of safetensors, ~15.8 GB of weights per rank at TP4. A 1280x720 image is 880 merged vision tokens.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 600 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm, ONE turn: eight distinct 1280x720 JPEGs plus 64 tokens of text in, 16 tokens out, `ignore_eos` and temperature 0.0. Built as NINE data sources -- one `synthetic_text` and eight `synthetic_image`, each with its own seed -- because guidellm reads `images_per_request` as a TURN count, so a single source asking for eight images emits an eight-turn conversation of one image each instead of one request carrying eight.
purpose: A visual comparison assistant answering eight-photo questions with brief replies, four concurrent users, four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Four H100s of one node serving a 32B vision-language model at TP4
# over the OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. Stock settings; nothing here is tuned.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct
tp-size: 4

# `ServerArgs.enable_multimodal` defaults to None (decided from the model); set explicitly here.
enable-multimodal: true

trust-remote-code: true
random-seed: 42
